title: Aligned frame composition: κ=5.2789616935221e-5 with Lean arithmetic certificate
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

The aligned frame composition certifies the conditional saving **κ = 52789616935221/10^18 = 5.2789616935221e-5 ≈ 2^(-14.2093862772)**, a **37.2695587404% increase over the original #36 κ=384569/10^10**. Its exact bit saving is **10558480765231/200000000000000000**. Exact rational values are authoritative. This is approximately **0.01415763596% above reported #74** at `428b5c167686b42a83f1abf7003c6d17aec561ea`, and above the pinned #88 construction `3ffd9b1dc7ef2978fa1831fe3850cd4f534aea70`. The reported external witness is accepted as a working baseline; no foreign producer replay is claimed.

The selected h23/h25 partitions are `['first6',1,1]` / `['first9',1,1,2]`, with six/nine anchored pairs, depth-coarse word `hhh`, PR74 node order and its updated coordinate maps. The unchanged independently audited R10 compiler supplies future-compatible completion, exact retired/pending indexes and next-use prices, bounded single/two-cycles, h23 baseline output order, and h25 late output order with coordinate-aware pricing and three-cycle exchange. There are 26,387/34,772 auxiliary roles, width **W=130,417,912**, complete rank **74,988,452,500**, and deficit **1,846,900**. All recursive children are positive and at most 529<575; copied centers, endpoint copies, cleanup and data growth remain paid.

The proof in `research/aligned-composition/PROOF.md` establishes general partition/anchoring/coarse compatibility, source identity, and exact finite physical/profile/arithmetic claims. The conditional all-size conclusion still relies on the inherited framed/residual compiler, recursion, finite scalar overhead, routing, prime/precision selection, recovery, fixed-tape implementation and analytic transfer. Arithmetic cutoffs are not full operational thresholds; no practical benchmark or global optimum is asserted. The finite portfolio compares 59,045 complete paid pairs, with two equivalent winners differing only in the inactive h23 three-cycle setting.

The additive `formal/lean/KappaCheck/AlignedFrameComposition.lean` extends the inherited #26 arithmetic checks with **197 rational arithmetic theorems**: supplied child counts, width/rank/deficit, rational accepted/rejected moment bounds, 47 strict slacks, seven strict margins and adjacent-grid rejection. Physical derivation of supplied arrays, real logarithm/exponential enclosure validity and all-size transfer remain external hypotheses. The module is byte-identical to its independent review and Lean/mathlib 4.21.0 compile receipt. Root imports, all 197 axiom entries and all 295 declaration/source rows are added without dropping earlier checks. The inherited axiom-output parser now trims comma-separated tokens so Lean's wrapped lists of allowed axioms are accepted; regressions still reject forbidden axioms, missing theorems and duplicate output.

Source credits: @eumemic [#57](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/57) and [#69](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/69), reversible compilation and coarse factoring; @rohangar1 [#59](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/59), split recursion; @ikeboy [#62](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/62), interval strips and core-aware assembly; @DominikScholz [#63](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/63) and [#68](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/68), ranked profiles and live pending controls; @rohanarun [#65](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/65), [#67](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/67), [#78](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/78) and [#82](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/82), exact refined assembly, profile-cost reclamation, coordinate search and coordinate-aware pricing; @alejandrozu [#70](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/70), bounded carry exchange; Thomas DiFiore (@tomdif) [#74](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/74), aligned firstK partitions, multi-pair anchoring, depth-coarse factoring, node order and selected coordinate maps; @chafreaky [#60](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/60), [#71](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/71), [#79](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/79), [#84](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/84), [#88](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/88) and this composition, anchored splits, completion, indexed reclamation, next-use scores, two/three-cycle composition, bounded search and certification.

Chafik Boukhalfa prepared this package with OpenAI Codex assistance. All contributor originals, Apache-2.0, OpenAI/manuscript and AI-assistance notices remain attached, including Avi Eisenberg's Claude assistance and earlier OpenAI disclosures. The complete 1,290-file PR88 construction, updated 17-file PR74 source with fetch metadata, and all prior archives are preserved byte-for-byte.

## Validation

Frozen source: `research/aligned-composition/SOURCE.json`, **2,720 pins**, SHA256 `7dcf54d1a136cc45fee258bdff80b191069c368a4a466b5862ad54d4623f2f57`. Construction commit: `264f202b52edc04d0c72ca9cb3138282ca68b9ad`.

`make aligned-composition-verify` passes: exact regeneration of both original and relabeled words; full ordinary/dirty basis replay in both orientations; fresh actual-frame CRT profiles; two independent rational moment enclosures; complete-profile comparisons; all 47 strict constraints and seven margins; neighboring 10^-18 rejection; eight actual-source strategy/Lean linkage audits; 33 physical/configuration/partition controls and four axiom-output parser regressions. Independent selected-witness clearance checks every physical/profile binding and all 59,045 paid pairs. Independent portable audit checks source, archive, proof, runtime, exact word/profile/arithmetic and additive formal integration bindings.

Full expanded sequential `make -j1 verify` passed all **15 verification groups** on clean construction `264f202b52edc04d0c72ca9cb3138282ca68b9ad` in **2110.262 seconds**: **653 tests in 92 isolated modules** and **20 patch-application checks**, with regenerated files byte-clean and the source freeze unchanged. Construction CI passed all 48 checks. Final receipt-only commit `8d1a0838f3e906d372818df02b3564c8b36495cc` adds this verification record and the exact completed #88 validation receipt from `d5a5b936844104db18c5bdd871f89da2fbf99551`, without changing the frozen witness, immutable PR88 construction archive or Lean module; **all 48 final-head CI checks pass**, including the integrated historical Lean package and both other inherited formal packages. Reproduce with `make aligned-composition-verify`, `make verify`, and `make formal-historical-verify`.
